status.summary: Former UFC middleweight champion (interim title over Yoel Romero at UFC 213, Jul 2017; lost the title to Israel Adesanya by KO at UFC 243, Oct 2019). After a submission loss to Khamzat Chimaev (Oct 2024) and a split-decision loss to Reinier de Ridder (Jul 26, 2025), he moved to light heavyweight and stopped Nikita Krylov at 1:01 of R3 at UFC 329 (Jul 11, 2026): Krylov turned away clutching his jaw after a combination and the referee stepped in (CBS Sports). Pro record 27-9 (Wikipedia, Sherdog, MMA Fighting, MMA Junkie; ESPN shows 28-9, which does not match the fight-by-fight record), UFC 18-7. Ranked #11 at light heavyweight on both UFC lists. Booked: vs Bogdan Guskov (18-4-1) in the co-main event of UFC Fight Night 298 at Afterpay Arena, Sydney, on Feb 6, 2027 (US date; Feb 7 local), headlined by Quillan Salkilld vs Benoit Saint Denis. It is his first fight in Australia since UFC 243 and his first in Sydney since 2014. He says other opponents turned the fight down before Guskov accepted. Age 35. No injury reported in the coverage checked.
status.ranking: #11 light heavyweight (UFC media panel, Nov 3-5, 2026; also #11 in the Meta UFC Rankings of Oct 31, 2026; read from ufcrankings.org and ufcalendar.com mirrors because ufc.com returned 403). MMA Fighting's own global rankings put him #12.

style.summary: A compact, explosive striker who works from range, comes in with fast punches to the head and has finished fights with punches, head kicks and a knee. He has been hard to take down for most of his career. Heavy punchers have dropped him eight times in the UFC, and since 2024 the grapplers have caught up with him. His one UFC fight at light heavyweight, in Jul 2026, ended in a knockout win.

moves.notes: Group shares follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 87.8% head, 4.6% body, 7.6% leg (career 83.6/7.3/9.1). The middleweight league split is 77.2/14.0/8.8, so he is far more head-focused and throws about a third of the league share to the body. Leg work comes and goes: 28 of 28 vs Costa (Feb 2024), none vs Krylov or De Ridder. 90% of his landed sig is at distance. In the head group the cross and overhand are high as a judgment: his recent finishes are punches to the head at distance (Krylov, Aliskerov), though ufcstats does not name the punch. The jab and hook are close behind, as a judgment for a blitzing striker. Head kicks get 0.08 because two of his UFC KOs are head kicks at distance (Brunson 2016, Souza 2017), though both are old. The body group leans to kicks as a judgment, since his body attempts are rare and all at distance. Leg weights are an even split because no source in this pass separates calf from inside kicks. The knee gets 0.05 for the Hester clinch-knee TKO. The karate-based, in-and-out style behind the archetype comes from pre-2026 coverage that could not be re-opened in this pass.
